name: Universal
source: Universal Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NAICOM publication approval NAICOM/TD/SUP/FA/RIC-019, 25 June 2026), consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed in NGN thousands and stored here in absolute NGN. EBIT = printed Net Insurance and Investment Result less printed Other Expenses; Net Finance Costs = printed insurance finance expense residual (Insurance Service Result + Net Investment Income less Net Insurance and Investment Result).

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Printed line Insurance Revenue: 13,760,500 and 8,006,851 (NGN thousands).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Insurance service expenses plus net expense from reinsurance contracts held.

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Printed subtotal Insurance service result.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention for an expense line; the two older columns were stored positive

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.not_available: The document prints an insurance service result rather than an operating profit line, so no value is shown.
rows.formula: Net Insurance and Investment Result less Other Expenses; insurance finance expense (residual of printed subtotals)

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.not_available: No net finance cost line is printed for these years.
rows.formula: Net Insurance and Investment Result less Other Expenses; insurance finance expense (residual of printed subtotals)

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Printed line Profit before Tax for the two newest columns.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Printed line Income Tax Expense for the two newest columns, stored as a positive charge.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf), Group column. Printed line Profit for the Year for the two newest columns.

rows.label: EPS
rows.unit_note: naira per share. The two newest cells are the printed kobo values divided by 100 (12.13 and 3.31 kobo); the FY2022 and FY2021 cells were read from a naira-denominated source and are scaled by 100 here. Both tie to the stored Profit for the Year divided by the 16,000,000,000 shares.

rows.label: Operating Margin (%)
rows.not_available: No operating profit line for these years, so no margin is shown.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.not_available: Total equity per year is not established in this file after the column correction, so no ratio is shown.

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.not_available: Total assets per year is not established in this file after the column correction, so no ratio is shown.

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.not_available: Balance sheet columns per year are not established in this file after the column correction, so no ratio is shown.

periods_note: columns dropped: FY2021 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
